> Read one SDRF-Proteomics file as its header and rows of raw cells, keeping repeated column names and ragged rows exactly as written.

Wire verb `sdrf read` · Python [`pymzlib.sdrf.read`][pymzlib.sdrf.read]

### Wraps

- [`SdrfDocument.LoadResults`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfDocument.cs) in `mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfDocument.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`
- [`SdrfHeader`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfHeader.cs) in `mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfHeader.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`
- [`SdrfRow.Cells`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfRow.cs) in `mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfRow.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `path` | required | — | — | A .sdrf.tsv file. |
| `offset` | `int` | `0` | rows | `>= 0` | Skip this many data rows. The whole file is parsed on every call. |
| `limit` | `int` | absent | rows | `>= 0` | Return at most this many data rows. Absent means every row. |

### Returns

Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `string` | — | never | The path as given. |
| `column_names` | `string[]` | — | never | The header, verbatim and in order. A LIST that may repeat names (comment[modification parameters] up to eight times) and may contain empty names; a name identifies a position, not a column. |
| `row_count` | `int` | rows | never | Data rows in the whole file, before the window. |
| `returned_count` | `int` | rows | never | Rows in rows. |
| `offset` | `int` | rows | never | The offset applied. |
| `truncated` | `bool` | — | never | True whenever rows were left out by offset or limit, including an offset past the end. |
| `rows` | `string[][]` | — | never | One list of raw cells per row, row-major. RAGGED: a row may be shorter than column_names; a missing position is absent, not empty. |
| `caveats` | `string[]` | — | never | Three static caveats, plus a count of short rows over the WHOLE document when any row is short. |

### Errors

| Kind | pyMzLib raises | When |
|---|---|---|
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | path missing or blank; offset or limit negative or not an integer |
| `correctness` | [`BridgeError`][pymzlib.BridgeError] | mzLib cannot read the file (MzLibException for an empty or missing file) |
| `service_unavailable` | [`ServiceUnavailableError`][pymzlib.ServiceUnavailableError] | never raised by this verb |

### Caveats

- readers read-records also opens .sdrf.tsv, but joins each row's cells with ';' into one string that cannot be split back, because the SDRF grammar is itself ';'-delimited. Use this verb for SDRF.
- offset and limit window after a full parse.

### Example

```python
doc = pymzlib.sdrf.read('PXD000070.sdrf.tsv')
```
